name: FloPlast 110mm Grey Soil Pipe Strap on Pipe Connector
description: The FloPlast Soil Pipe Strap on Pipe Connector allows you to add a waste pipe to a soil system without the use of a fitting. Simple calculate the point at which you want the waste pipe to enter the soil pipe, cut a hole in the pipe using a 54-56mm hole cutter and locate strap boss. For extra protection you use either silicone or solvent cement around the hole to avoid any potential leaks. Once located fit the appropriate adaptor it will allow 32mm, 40mm and 50mm waste pipes to be connected to the soil stack.

name: FloPlast OS16W White Overflow System Pipe Clip 21.5mm - Pack of 4
description: FloPlast OS16W White Overflow System Pipe Clip is designed to securely hold 21.5mm overflow pipe in place. These clips provide a simple and effective solution for tidying and supporting your overflow system pipework. Their white finish ensures a neat and unobtrusive appearance. Note that no expansion gap is required on solvent weld overflow systems, and pipe clips should be fixed at maximum 1.2m centres for vertical runs and 0.5m centres for horizontal runs. This comes in a pack of 4 and is ideal for both professional and DIY use.
